PreToolUse.command: FILE_PATH=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]+\.py"' | grep -oE '[^"]+\.py' | head -1); case "$FILE_PATH" in */src/*|*/scripts/*) if [ -f "$FILE_PATH" ]; then python correctness/checks/check_pipelines.py "$FILE_PATH" || { echo 'Pipeline style gate: see legibility/style-pipelines.md'; exit 2; }; fi ;; esac
